game.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
game.blurb: Realistic first-person medieval RPG from Warhorse Studios (published by Deep Silver), released 2018-02-13. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours (well under a full run). Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Henry, a blacksmith's son, is caught up in a civil war after his village is attacked. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Quests, Travel and the Countryside
chapters.summary: Side quests, locations, shrines and crosses, the Talmberg horse race, the Rattay tourney, hunting, reputation, dice and money.

chapters.title: Skills and Combat
chapters.summary: Levels, Speech, combos, headshots and stealth kills.

chapters.title: Daily Life and Survival
chapters.summary: Food, sleep, drink, books, potions, herbs, theft and time in prison.

chapters.title: Rebuilding Pribyslavitz
chapters.summary: Getting the village of Pribyslavitz renewed and making it pay.

chapters.title: Later Add-on Achievements
chapters.summary: The block of achievements listed after Theresa's story: Pavel's treasure, Henslin, Johanka and more.

chapters.title: Hardcore Mode
chapters.summary: Finishing the game in Hardcore Mode, with or without all the negative perks.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Kingdom Come: Deliverance" or "Kingdom Come Deliverance". kingdomcomedeliverance.fandom.com answers the API, with about 61 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 46 of 82 Steam achievements are hidden. "Woman's Lot" (complete Theresa's story) matches the A Woman's Lot entry in RAWG's search results. The 8 achievements listed after it (4 hidden, 4 visible, from "Bad Girl" to "Cleric's Pet") were grouped by schema position into "Later Add-on Achievements"; the data does not say which add-on they belong to, so this needs checking. The hidden ones between "Bailiff" and "Arena Master"/"Death by Splinter" (positions 54 to 73, such as "Trial-and-Error", "Lord Capon's Ghost", "Mercenary's Honour") sit in the main story chapter with all other hidden ones; many of them have low unlock rates and are probably side quests or add-on content. "Merciful" (hidden, 0.9 percent) is also in the main story chapter as a placeholder.
